stem:
The diagram shows a pinhole camera. Farhan points the tiny hole at a bright lamp and looks at the screen at the back.

What image should form on the screen?

options.text: An upside-down image of the lamp, also reversed left to right.
An upright image of the lamp, reversed left to right.
A bright patch with the same shape as the pinhole, not an image of the lamp.
An upside-down image of the lamp even if the pinhole faces away from the lamp.

teacher.key_rationale: Light from the lamp passes through the tiny hole and falls on the screen, forming an inverted image of the lamp (upside down and left-right reversed). The hole must face the lamp, and the image is of the lamp, not of the hole's shape.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source converging-lens ray diagram into a labelled pinhole camera with lamp, hole, and screen.
